passages.text:
Happy New Year!
I hope you have time to attend today's webinar on "Information Disorder and Its Threat to Democracy"
Dr. Rogers is the Co-Founder and Executive Director at the Global Disinformation Index, an NGO that aims to catalyze
change in the tech industry to disincentivize the creation and dissemination of online disinformation.
Thanks,
Daniel
Information Disorder and Its Threat to Democracy
When Wed Jan 5, 2022 1pm - 2pm Eastern Time - New York
[opaque block]
Joining info
[opaque block]
Who (Guest list is too large to display)
"Information Disorder and Its Threat to Democracy"
The Office of Security (SEC) and Bureau for Development, Democracy and Innovation, Center for Democracy, Human
Rights and Governance (DDI/DRG) invites you to join us for a discussion on mis-dis-and mal-information and its
threat to democracy with Dr. Daniel Rogers, the Co-Founder and Executive Director at the Global Disinformation
Index, an NGO that aims to catalyze change in the tech industry to disincentivize the creation and dissemination of
online disinformation.
Dr. Rogers is a physicist, an author, and an expert in cryptography, cybercrime, disinformation, and security. He
currentlyteaches intheCybercrimeand Global Security Masters Program at New York University and serves as a
Technical Advisor for the United Nations Development Programme. His presentation will highlight the complexities of
defining disinformation and discuss tangible ways to counter it.
This presentation is co-sponsored by DDI/DRG, which recently released USAID's Disinformation Primer, and is part of
the quarterly SEC Guest Speaker Series which aims to help all USAID staff better understand security-related issues
impacting our work.
Any questions concerning this information mav be directed to Daniel Stolkowski ([contact omitted]) and Dian:
Parzik ([contact omitted])
